Disabling include_document_structure still produces content without the document tree overhead

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<article><h1>Heading</h1><p>Paragraph body.</p></article>"#;
    let options_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"include_document_structure":false}"#).unwrap();
    let options: ConversionOptions = serde_json::from_value(options_json).unwrap();
    let _ = convert(html, Some(options.clone()));
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
